errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос е етикетирана "Perplexity" и показва стойности в логаритмична скала, която започва от 1 и се простира до 50, с интервали съответстващи на степента на 10
errors.evidence: The vertical axis uses a logarithmic scale with values at 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3, not starting from 1 and extending to 50.
The description incorrectly states that the blue bars (Per-Output) only include sparsity rates up to 60%, but the figure shows values up to 80%.
The description incorrectly states that the orange bars (Per-Layer) only include sparsity rates up to 60%, but the figure shows values up to 80%.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категории, които представляват sparsity rate, подредени в низходящ ред, започвайки от 10% и достигайки до 80%
errors.evidence: The sparsity rate on the x-axis is arranged in ascending order, not descending.
The description does not mention that at 60% sparsity, the orange bar slightly exceeds 10^1 while the blue bar remains below it.
The description does not mention that at 70% sparsity, both bars exceed 10^1.
The description does not mention that at 80% sparsity, the orange bar approaches 10^3 while the blue bar is slightly below it.
The description does not explicitly state that all values remain below 10^1 up to 50% sparsity.
The description incorrectly limits the sparsity rates for both Per-Output and Per-Layer to 60%, but the figure includes 70% and 80%.

errors.text_span: Стълбите са подредени според стойностите на sparsity rate, като по-високите стълби представляват по-високи стойности на Per-Output и Per-Layer sparsity rate
errors.evidence: The phrasing is ambiguous; it suggests that the bars themselves represent sparsity rate values, rather than perplexity values for given sparsity rates.

errors.text_span: Освен това стълбите са визуално подчертани с различни цвят, което улеснява разграничаването между двете мерки на sparsity rate
errors.evidence: The description is unnecessarily repetitive, as the color distinction was already mentioned earlier.
